visual.general_description: Four color intraoral clinical photographs labelled A to D showing dark brown-black pigmented lesions of the oral mucosa, with gloved hands, a tongue depressor and a retractor.
visual.detailed_description: A 2 by 2 arrangement of intraoral photographs. A (upper left) shows the retracted upper lip mucosa with a dark brown-black patch. B (upper right) shows a dark patch on the upper vestibular mucosa and a small dark spot on the gingiva. C (lower left) shows the cheek retracted by a wooden tongue depressor, with dark spots on teeth and faint mucosal darkening. D (lower right) shows the extended tongue held with gauze and a plastic retractor. Panel letters are printed in white boxes at the lower left of each panel; there are no scale bars, arrows or other text.

panels.detailed_description: A gloved finger at upper left and another at right retract the lip. A dark brown to black, irregular pigmented band lies on the inner surface of the upper lip mucosa in the upper half of the frame, with pinker lip mucosa below it. A few upper teeth are visible at the lower edge, with a gap between teeth. The label "A" is printed in a white box at lower left. No scale bar, text or identifying marks are visible.

visual.general_description: Four microscopy panels: two pink-purple hematoxylin-eosin-appearing sections (printed C and D) above two brown chromogen immunostained sections (printed A and B), each with a scale bar.
visual.detailed_description: A 2 by 2 arrangement of light microscopy images. The top row, printed as panels C (left) and D (right), shows pink-purple stained stratified epithelium with dark brown pigment, yellow arrows in C and a white arrow in D, scale bars 100 µm (first digit blurred) and 50 µm. The bottom row, printed as panels A (left) and B (right), shows brown chromogen stained epithelium on a pale blue-green counterstain with scattered darker dendritic-shaped cells, scale bars 200 µm and 50 µm. Letters are printed in white boxes at the lower left of each panel.

panels.general_description: Brown immunohistochemical staining of an epithelial section with a scale bar.
panels.detailed_description: Pale blue-green counterstained tissue with brown chromogen staining spread through a thick epithelial band running diagonally from upper left to lower right, with scattered dark brown-red elongated cells in the underlying connective tissue at lower left. A black scale bar at lower right is printed "200 µm". The label "A" is printed in a white box at lower left.

imaging_modalities.visual_cue: Brown chromogen immunostained section with scale bar

evidence.quote: Oral melanoacanthoma. (C) and (D) positive HMB-45 expression in dendritic melanocytes extending across the epithelium
